title: Tiny Planets
author: Bankaren
selftext:
I picked up my 6 best vibe coders to develop a game, whilst of course tokenmaxxing. Everything has been developed using AI. This is where we are.

**Tiny Planets** *(or as I'd rather call it, Alien Whale: Escape or Death, but got downvoted)* is a co-op roguelike for up to 6 friends. Hop between tiny procedural planets, grab what you can and get out before the giant Alien Whale eats it. Give us a better name.

Everything is AI, surprise, but we know what we're doing, we think.

How a run works:

* The crew votes on where to go next, which is why you will absolutely end up on the wrong planet
* Drop down in the lander, a subway car with rocket thrusters strapped to it
* Mine ore, upgrade the ship, boot-jump to the moon, annoy your friends with water pistols
* Get everyone back aboard before the whale arrives

The real vision: roughly 30-minute runs, the whale closing in with every jump, risky routes for better loot, and eventually getting strong enough to fight back. We are still thinking about the full end-game experience. So any input here is valuable.

What would you want to see?

* **Planets:** regular planets, black holes, cheese worlds, casino planets...?
* **Missions:** Between each round a mini-game will play out, what kind of mini-games are fun?
* **Friendslop:** what makes your favourite "friendslop" games Lethal Company, REPO or Peak etc. fun for you? (We LOVE all of these games, we just categorise them this way)

Best ideas go straight into the next build (new build is out faster than the 5h Opus reset) 🐋
